address_mandatory.label: Customer address mandatory
address_mandatory.description: Every invoice must carry the customer's service address.
address_mandatory.assumption: About 3% of jobs under $300 stop being invoiced through ScanPay (taken from no-address jobs).

keyed_block_over_1000.label: No keyed-in cards above $1,000
keyed_block_over_1000.description: Card-not-present (keyed) payments above $1,000 are blocked; the customer pays by tap/chip instead.
keyed_block_over_1000.assumption: About 8% of those jobs are lost; the rest pay card-present.

signed_estimate_over_500.label: Signed estimate above $500
signed_estimate_over_500.description: Jobs above $500 need a signed estimate before work starts.
signed_estimate_over_500.assumption: No jobs lost (brief: no side effects unless argued otherwise).

photos_required.label: Before and after photos required
photos_required.description: Every job needs before and after photos attached before the payment is taken.
